answer: Entry is billed by variance, not stake. (1) Each seat reports one noisy reading per epoch; the registry averages them. (2) Effective sample size is n over the design effect, one plus rho(n minus one), rho the measured report correlation. (3) A solo agent with rho near zero pays nothing; five hundred clones from one operator hold rho near 0.9, collapsing effective size to 1.1, the bill to 112,500 sigma squared. (4) Spreading over epochs fails: rho is tracked per operator across all history. A farm pays to blind the instrument it reads: a falcon in a harbor counts one ripple, not a lagoon.
